'''''Billbergia vittata''''' is a plant [[species]] in the family [[Bromeliaceae]]. 

It is a tough hardy tubular shaped plant heavily festooned with silver trichomes in a distinctive banded pattern that boldly contrasts with the leaf pigments. The tube form is about 500 - 600mm high and retains a reservoir of water in the tube. The plant produces a brilliant red pink pendulous inflorescence with a series of small blue flowers, on whose nectar honey eaters such as the [[Eastern spinebill|Eastern Spinebill]] feed.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Billbergia vittata, catalogue of Bromeliad plants |url=https://www.lloydgodman.net/Photosynthesis/PHoToS/Billb/vit.htm |access-date=28 November 2023 |website=www.lloydgodman.net }}</ref>

This species is [[Native plant|native]] to Brazil.
